summary: Getty Images Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting termination of its merger agreement with Shutterstock, Inc., entered into January 6, 2025. The Getty board resolved not to proceed with a sale of Shutterstock's editorial business required by the UK CMA, a condition Getty was not obligated to accept, and let the deal's extended end date of July 6, 2026 pass. Getty delivered a termination notice to Shutterstock on July 7, 2026. Following termination, Getty's 10.500% senior secured notes due 2030 will be redeemed per the indenture. No break fee was disclosed. Watch for any potential litigation or shareholder actions.
